title: Green Fee Award Registry Manifest (demonstration, v0.2)
description: One fiscal-year cohort of award registry records. v0 is a demonstration schema: `sample: true` is REQUIRED at both cohort and record level (const), so real program data cannot validate against it — removing that guard is a deliberate, versioned schema change, not a data change. v0.2 adds `location`, a cadastral cross-reference axis (TMK) with the same sample guard philosophy: the fixed division digit 9 belongs to no county, so a real TMK cannot validate. The registry governs identity, cohort membership, publication eligibility, and route generation; it never replaces the State program record it points to.

id.description: Immutable award identity. Never reissued, never renamed — the same rule as a printed asset code.

moku.description: Stewardship context: the moku the project serves (regional axis — whose place). Distinct from any HRS §205-2 land use district (regulatory axis); the registry never carries regulatory authority.

act96Alignment.description: Sample alignment categories for demonstration. The authoritative Act 96 alignment mapping is program methodology, decided by the State — not by this registry.

publicationStatus.description: Monotonic publication gate: draft → validated → published. Only `published` records build public pages or export in the published manifest. A human publishes, never an automated process.

location.description: Cadastral cross-reference axis (which parcel) — the third axis alongside moku (regional — whose place), and distinct from any regulatory land use district. The registry stores keys only; parcel geometry, ownership, and taxation context stay with the county and State parcel layers it joins against (the State-owned map destination lives in links.webMapId). Integration services (e.g. Mokunet) resolve TMKs against those authoritative layers — the registry never carries geometry.

tmk.description: Tax Map Key cross-references, normalized division-zone-section-plat-parcel with optional 4-digit CPR unit. null = the footprint has no parcel identity (nearshore/marine waters, multi-parcel corridors); geoContext must then name the footprint (validator invariant). v0 sample guard: the division digit is fixed at 9 — no county uses it (real divisions are 1 Oʻahu, 2 Maui, 3 Hawaiʻi, 4 Kauaʻi) — so a real TMK cannot validate. Widening the pattern to [1-4] is a deliberate, versioned schema change, exactly like removing sample:true.

geoContext.description: Plain-language footprint note: required (non-null) whenever tmk is null (names the non-parcel footprint — nearshore waters, trail corridor), optional context otherwise.

story.description: Awardee-voice narrative. Serves only when published.

links.description: ArcGIS integration points (State-owned destinations). Null until the State registers a destination; the portal links to authority, it never replaces it.

provenance.description: The chain every public claim must walk: page → published record → manifest → program record → authoritative source.
